avis.conclusion: Having evaluated all the evidence provided by the Applicants to support the safe use of the three prostaglandin analogues (PGAs) - Isopropyl Cloprostenate, Methylamido-Dihydro- Noralfaprostal and Dechloro Dihydroxy Difluoro Ethylcloprostenolamide - the SCCS is of the opinion that none of them can be considered safe for use in cosmetic products intended for promoting the growth of eyelashes and eyebrows.
